evidenceContract.userBehavior: $media-preparation 读取 @production-brief.md 和 @source-page.png，为已确认的三镜动画 PV 准备下一批静态素材输入，说明各项用途、提示词、验收和后续依赖。有人建议先将三个漫画面板去字扩成 16:9，再直接做视频。请判断并继续准备；本轮只交付准备方案，不生成或修改媒体。

observables.description: Exact Skill injection and model identity, creator-facing preparation inputs, no generation calls; semantic design quality is assessed separately.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: Prepare distinct reusable traveler, lamp and connected shaft environment design inputs before dependent shot frames. Extract evidenced identity/material/structure without locking panel anatomy or perspective defects; label reverse-side designs as adaptation. Separate source pages, design sheets and frames, choose formats by role, and require visible design acceptance rather than media probes. Account for all SH01–SH03 dependencies and remain in static preparation. Apply the approved stylized 3D target, not source hatching; prepare required character views and lamp states with shared proportions, handedness, materials and anchor-first dependencies.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Panel cleanup/outpainting substituted for asset design; inherited broken walkway or arm geometry; invented rear views claimed as canon; every design sheet forced to 16:9; readable files or three cleaned panels counted as complete coverage; video preparation or generation before critical assets; falsely claiming that no crop command makes design generation impossible. Source hatching imposed despite approved 3D direction; a view list counted as images; inconsistent independently invented views; turnaround used as video first frame.
